questions.questionText: Record the journal entry for purchasing office equipment for $50,000, paying $20,000 cash and balance on credit.
questions.referenceAnswer:
Equipment A/c Dr. $50,000
  To Cash A/c $20,000
  To Accounts Payable A/c $30,000
(Being equipment purchased partly in cash and partly on credit)
acceptableAlternatives: Trade Creditors in place of Accounts Payable

questions.questionText: Explain the market equilibrium effect of an increase in raw material costs using a supply-demand curve diagram.
questions.referenceAnswer: An increase in raw material costs decreases supply, shifting supply curve leftward from S1 to S2. Demand remains unchanged. Equilibrium price rises from P1 to P2, and equilibrium quantity falls from Q1 to Q2.
expectedConcepts: Supply curve shifts leftward (S1 to S2)
acceptableAlternatives: Price increase and quantity decrease graphical demonstration
markingCriteria: 3 marks for correct labeled supply-demand curve shift graph
diagramReferences: Supply and Demand curve graph showing S1->S2 left shift, price increase P1->P2, quantity decrease Q1->Q2
